_readme: Edit this file to change links, lead routing and capability status without touching code. Values marked TODO must be verified before launch. Never put API keys or secrets here: this file is public.

site._canonicalNote: TODO: placeholder domain. Confirm ownership, then run `python3 tools/build.py` so canonical, hreflang and sitemap URLs are regenerated.
site._deployBasePathNote: URL folder the site is served from. Used only by 404.html (GitHub Pages serves it at any depth). '/kabuk-platform/' for https://sharifh.github.io/kabuk-platform/; set to '/' on a custom domain, then rebuild. All other pages use relative paths and need no setting.

brand.name: KabuK Platform
brand._logoNote: Official KabuK brush mark from the KabuK design library, paired with the 'Platform' descriptor. A dedicated KabuK Platform lockup has not been approved yet.

urls._note: TODO: verify each URL. adminConsole is not linked publicly.

capabilityStatus._values: core | development | planned. 'core' = a foundation service area within KabuK Platform, scoped per engagement (not a claim of standalone public availability). Confirm with product before launch.

channelStatus._values: eligible | pilot | planned. How each KabuK distribution channel is labelled for hotels. 'eligible' = available to properties that meet eligibility and approval (never automatic). Confirmed 2026-10-16: HafH and KabuK Exchange are pilot; Omakastay is planned.

modules._values: hidden | comingSoon. Gates hotel features that are not live. 'comingSoon' shows a labelled register-interest module; 'hidden' removes it everywhere. There is deliberately no 'live' value: publishing as live needs approved copy (data rights, methodology, pricing, eligibility) and a code change.

leads._formModeNote: Only 'mailto' is implemented. A backend/CRM endpoint is proposed in docs/CHANGELOG.md but does not exist yet.
leads._routesNote: TODO: replace every example.com address with a monitored KabuK Style inbox.
